name: Apex Legacy 300K
source: Account holder 2026-09-28: "legacy 300k", "35 mini contract limit", "max DD of 7500", "the profit goal is 20000, 0 daily drawdown, and EOD trail locks at +100". Minimum days and consistency were not named: taken as the Legacy 50K's (none; a single day can pass). Floor: $7,500 below the EOD peak, locking at $300,100 (+$100) once the EOD peak reaches +$7,600.
notes: Max size 35 minis = 350 micros. NOT enforced by the simulator.
Trailing max loss is END OF DAY: the floor moves up with the EOD peak and never down, and locks at +$100 ($300,100) once EOD profit reaches +$7,600.
No daily loss limit (account holder: "0 daily drawdown").
No consistency rule and no minimum days were named: assumed as the Legacy 50K (a single +$20,000 day passes).
